headline: Super vs Folk — Personal AI Agents for Real Computer Work

site_brief.goal: Create a fair but persuasive competitor comparison page for Super vs Folk. Use supplied sources for current facts, avoid fake claims, and make the practical argument that Super is better suited for repeated computer-use work because its cache can lower repeated execution cost.
site_brief.title: Super vs Folk

summary: A fair comparison for people evaluating Super and Folk. Folk fits lightweight, conversational assistance and niche workflows. Super is built for users who want a personal AI agent that can actually operate a computer and reuse a computer-use cache, making repeated workflows faster and cheaper over time. The page also situates both tools in the wider agent landscape alongside ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Siri, and Orchids.
